$4y \log_y(x) = 10 \implies \log_y(x) = \frac{10}{4y} = \frac{5}{2y}$

Since $\log_y(x) = \frac{1}{\log_x(y)}$, we can substitute the expressions we found:
$\frac{5}{2y} = \frac{1}{\frac{10}{x}} = \frac{x}{10}$
